title: Juicy Turkish Anchovy Stir-fry
description: A fresh and quick meal-prep dish featuring juicy anchovy fillets in a flavorful stir-fry sauce, perfect for those following a low FODMAP diet.

ingredients.name: Onion Slices
ingredients.notes: To add sweetness and depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Red Peppers, finely chopped
ingredients.notes: To add color and heat if desired

instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add garlic, onion slices, and red peppers to the pan, stir-fry for about 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add anchovy fillets, soy sauce, and continue cooking for another minute.
Serve immediately as a light meal or add to a wrap with greens and seeds for a filling lunch.
